title: Mean restricted Fourier coefficient observation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $S\subseteq J$, and fix a sign assignment $z$ outside $J$. The mean, over a uniform sign assignment $Y$ on $J$, of $f$ evaluated at the combined assignment $(Y,z)$ times the monomial $\chi_S(Y)$ equals the Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the restriction of $f$ obtained by fixing the outside coordinates to $z$.
